lines:
Implemented the model-facing ask_user tool over the existing suspension contract, presented as a proper modal UI dialog.

Core. `tool.ask_user` and `tool.browse` are frozen native capabilities (`CapabilityKind::{AskUser, Browse}`, `authorityMode` `run_question`/`run_browse`, provider names `ask_user`/`browse`) admitted in Settings and in the frozen binding, side-effect free, owner-scoped per Chat, idempotent by command id, and excluded from the delegated-subagent selection. A question reuses the whole approval suspension rather than adding a channel: `ToolApprovalChallengeV1` and `GraphApprovalRequestV1` carry an optional question, the pass reports `GraphPassStatusV1::AwaitingAnswer`, the pipeline reports `WorkflowExecutionStatusV1::AwaitingAnswer`, and the service commits `question.asked` and the durable `awaiting_answer` phase. The question tools never reach an executor: the tool loop suspends with the question when no answer is recorded and settles the same call from the recorded answer afterwards, so an answer is delivered exactly once, a replayed resume re-delivers the committed outcome, a different answer is refused, and an unanswered question is never answered by a message, retry, restart or default. `resume_question` records the answer before resuming and reuses the approval resume body through a shared `commit_resumed_result`; `recover_committed_approval` was made reachable for the replay. Cancelling records `question.cancelled` and the model receives `cancelled: true` as an ordinary tool result.

Desktop. `question.asked`/`answered`/`cancelled` project into a `question` timeline card that keeps the prompt, the offered options and the answer, and the workspace raises a modal `<dialog>` (native element, so backdrop, focus trap, Escape and focus restoration come from the platform) for the unanswered question. Dismissing it leaves the card answerable and it never re-opens on its own; it closes when the answer commits. Answer and Skip dispatch a typed `question` intent. While the Run is `awaiting_answer` the composer disables ordinary send and queue, keeps the draft, and offers Stop.

Verification. Rust 403 passed with only the pre-existing `checkpoint_calling_an_unselected_capability_is_declined_without_ending_the_node` failure; four new pipeline tests cover the suspension shape and kind, the answer reaching the model once, the replay, a refused different answer, unknown and foreign question ids, the offered-option check, the cancelled question as an ordinary result and the chosen path. TypeScript `tsc --noEmit` clean; eight dialog tests and four workspace tests cover the dialog's labels, options, free text, declared default, skip, decide-later, rejected-answer state and the workspace auto-open, durable card, answer dispatch, dismissal and close-on-commit. Full vitest shows only the known pre-existing and load-flaky failures. The design model records the question reason, events, dialog, `awaiting_answer` phase and tool matrix; `docs/subagent-tool-inheritance.md` documents the feature.

Add the DSH tool-ask-user equivalent as a suspension-based question that reuses Aworkit's suspension and approval machinery instead of inventing a second interactive channel.

Current state. Aworkit has durable approval requests, Wait-for-Input suspension with deduplicated resume, and a composer, but no model-facing way to ask the user a question. Today a model must answer from assumption or end its turn.

Design fit.
- tool.ask_user submits a typed question (prompt, 1..n labelled options, optional free-text allowance, optional default) and suspends the Run with a new SuspensionReason::Question; the committed suspension is a QuestionAskedV1 event on the Chat stream.
- The composer/conversation presents the question as a typed card; the user's answer commits QuestionAnsweredV1 and is consumed exactly once on resume, producing one context revision with provenance (the same dedup and resume-once contract as Wait-for-Input). Cancelling or ending the Chat records QuestionCancelledV1 and follows the existing cancellation path.
- The tool is a normal frozen capability with authorityMode "run_question", owner-scoped per Chat, idempotent by command id, and no side effect. It appears in the frozen tool matrix and as a timeline card.
- Plan review reuses this suspension for its decision where the question is the approve/reject choice, so the product has exactly one way to interrupt a Run for a user decision.
- No-replay: recovery restores the committed waiting frontier; an unanswered question never auto-answers, never expires into a retry, and never silently defaults.

Agreed interface (confirmed 2026-09-21). The question is a proper modal UI dialog, not only an inline composer card. A committed question renders twice from one projection: a selectable `question` timeline card that keeps the prompt, options, chosen answer and terminal outcome visible in chronology, and a modal dialog that is the focused answering surface. The dialog uses role=dialog with aria-modal, a labelled heading, a focus trap, Escape precedence after nested controls, and focus restoration; it opens when an unanswered question arrives, can be dismissed without answering while leaving the card answerable later, never renders a stale question, never reopens an answered or cancelled one, and never blocks Run details inspection. The Run sits in a new `awaiting_answer` phase in which the composer disables ordinary send and queue and keeps the unsent draft; the answer can never be given by typing a normal message. The same dialog family presents a path question for the sibling browse capability (task 121), which uses the operating system's own file or folder chooser.

Non-goals. Unsolicited host notifications; questions asked outside an active Run; a parallel prompt UI.

Outputs. Tool manifest entry, schema, Settings admission and frozen binding; question suspension reason, event family and reducer; a `question` timeline card plus the modal dialog with answer controls, option group, optional free text, default marking, Skip, and keyboard accessibility; the awaiting_answer phase and composer behavior; resume-once typing; and tests for answer, cancellation, resume after restart, owner isolation, single consumption of the answer, dialog a11y, and no auto-answer.

data.title: Add a model-facing ask_user question tool over the suspension contract
